name: piston-retract-entity
comment: Retracting moving blocks against entities and ray traces, no redstone (as tick/piston-retract-unpowered: heads and stones at t=0, extended sticky pistons placed with set_block_silent at t=2 retract at once). Up: sticky piston (0,61,0) meta 9, head (0,62,0), stone (0,63,0); a cobblestone item spawned at t=2 at (0.2,62,0.2) in the head's cell, beside the arm, with zero motion. +x: sticky piston (3,61,4) meta 13, head (4,61,4), stone (5,61,4); an item at (4.5,61,4.5) in the head's cell. Covers BlockPistonMoving.getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool for retracting tile entities (box moved by -offset * progress: the item collides with the moving boxes), TileEntityPiston.func_31010_a on landing of a retracting tile entity (progress - 1 = 0: the box at the cell, entities pushed 0.25 along the facing), and BlockPistonMoving.setBlockBoundsBasedOnState through the ray_trace dumps (Block.collisionRayTrace) down the up column and along the +x row every tick.
